authorize_calendar_oauth_start(p_provide.reason: Batch 29: authorize the caller-owned existing Google connection. Other organization/chapter/unit calendars must not affect this caller-only result.

begin_sso_admin_action().reason: Batch 29: read nonempty caller-organization SSO metadata and its existing verification domain. Same-organization chapters intentionally share this administration; only another organization adds a distinct connection/domain.

close_vote_campaign(p_kind text, p_campa.reason: Batch 29: close the variant chapter open standard ballot, returning its fixture id. Unauthorized other chapters/organizations and absent ids must be campaign not found. Units reuse the chapter campaign.

delete_knowledge_collection(p_collection.reason: Batch 29: delete an existing chapter collection through its scoped lookup and return the remaining collection projection. Chapter context stays fixed while foreign ids vary; units share the chapter collection.

delete_vote_campaign_draft(p_kind text,.reason: Batch 29: delete the variant never-published draft ballot; foreign and absent ids must be campaign not found for chapter staff. Units share the chapter campaign.

disposition_failed_login_attempt(p_attem.reason: Batch 29: review a real open selected-organization attempt. Another organization and an absent attempt must be attempt not found; chapter/unit worlds intentionally reuse this organization-wide administration row.

get_ballot_tally(p_ballot_id text).reason: Batch 29: read an actual closed chapter ballot with one choice and one option. Foreign organization/chapter ballots must be unavailable; a unit has no separate ballot inventory.

get_compass_case_context(p_case_id uuid).reason: Batch 29: read real own case facts with the fixture enabling case help. Foreign organization, chapter and unit cases must be case unavailable exactly as absent ids are; the actual caller JWT remains fixed.

get_learning_history(p_chapter_id text,.reason: Batch 29: read nonempty authored content history in the caller-selected chapter, kept fixed while substituting a foreign content id. Other chapter/organization content must be content unavailable. Unit worlds share chapter content.

get_officer_removal_ballot_details(p_bal.reason: Batch 29: read actual officer-removal metadata from a real closed ballot. Unauthorized foreign ids must be omitted identically when present and absent. Units share chapter governance.

list_chapter_kb_revisions(p_article_id u.reason: Batch 29: read a real authored revision with no storage-derived dependency. The requested caller chapter stays fixed while the article id varies; other chapter/organization articles must be not found, exactly like missing ids. Units share the chapter article.

mark_vp_case_reviewed(p_case_id uuid).reason: Batch 29: review a real active overdue case in the selected chapter as its president. Other chapter/organization and absent cases must be attention case not found. The return contains the fixture case id and transaction time.

retire_chapter_kb_article(p_article_id u.reason: Batch 29: retire a real authored draft in the caller chapter, returning the existing article id and incremented version. Chapter argument stays fixed so foreign and missing articles are equally unavailable. Units share chapter knowledge.

review_weekly_poll_question(p_question_i.reason: Batch 29: reserve an actual unpublished selected-chapter question with a valid note. Foreign chapter/organization questions and absent ids must be editable weekly question not found. Unit worlds share chapter editorial work.

save_sso_connection(p_metadata_url text,.reason: Batch 29: save valid metadata into the existing selected-organization connection and return its real control projection. Other organizations cannot affect it; chapter/unit worlds share the existing organization record.

save_welcome_campaign(p_campaign_id uuid.reason: Batch 29: pause an existing selected-organization campaign using a fresh fixed operation key for each world. Foreign organization and missing ids must be not found. Same-organization chapters/units intentionally share the campaign.

second_ballot_nomination(p_nomination_id.reason: Batch 29: second an existing unseconded nomination by a different person on an own readable draft ballot. Other chapter/organization nominations must be nomination not found as absent ids are. Units share chapter nominations.

set_ballot_nominations_period(p_ballot_i.reason: Batch 29: save a future nomination deadline on an existing own unpublished draft. Other chapter/organization ballots and missing ids must be campaign not found for chapter staff. Units share the chapter draft.

set_knowledge_collection_item(p_collecti.reason: Batch 29: confirm an existing authored-article placement after real collection/article authorization. Its preseeded placement id avoids a generated response id. Chapter stays fixed; foreign collection/article pairs and absent pairs must be not found. Units share the chapter placement.

set_task_checkoff_list_status(p_task_id.reason: Batch 29: close an existing own chapter checkoff list as its creator, returning fixture list/entry identities. Unauthorized chapter/organization tasks must refuse as missing ids. Units share the chapter task.

update_chapter_space_content(p_id uuid,.reason: Batch 29: edit the real own chapter channel with valid bilingual text. Other chapter/organization channels must be space unavailable exactly as missing ids are. Unit worlds share the chapter channel.

update_organization_setting(p_key text,.reason: Batch 29: save a valid false contextual-nudges preference through the caller-organization writer. This legacy wrapper returns no wall-clock version, so the entire answer remains strict. No target organization parameter exists.

upsert_pay_scale_grade(p_expected_organi.reason: Batch 29: save the existing NI29 grade under an explicitly expected selected organization. Other-organization expected ids must be rejected independently of rows; chapters and units intentionally share an organization grade.
